name: ssm-incidents
description: Systems Manager Incident Manager is an incident management console designed to help users mitigate and recover from incidents affecting their Amazon Web Services-hosted applications.

subcommands.name: batch-get-incident-findings
subcommands.description: Retrieves details about all specified findings for an incident, including descriptive details about each finding.

subcommands.name: create-replication-set
subcommands.description: A replication set replicates and encrypts your data to the provided Regions with the provided KMS key.

subcommands.name: create-response-plan
subcommands.description: Creates a response plan that automates the initial response to incidents.

subcommands.name: create-timeline-event
subcommands.description: Creates a custom timeline event on the incident details page of an incident record.

subcommands.name: delete-incident-record
subcommands.description: Delete an incident record from Incident Manager.

subcommands.name: delete-replication-set
subcommands.description: Deletes all Regions in your replication set.

subcommands.name: delete-resource-policy
subcommands.description: Deletes the resource policy that Resource Access Manager uses to share your Incident Manager resource.

subcommands.name: delete-response-plan
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified response plan.

subcommands.name: delete-timeline-event
subcommands.description: Deletes a timeline event from an incident.

subcommands.name: get-incident-record
subcommands.description: Returns the details for the specified incident record.

subcommands.name: get-replication-set
subcommands.description: Retrieve your Incident Manager replication set.

subcommands.name: get-resource-policies
subcommands.description: Retrieves the resource policies attached to the specified response plan.

subcommands.name: get-response-plan
subcommands.description: Retrieves the details of the specified response plan.

subcommands.name: get-timeline-event
subcommands.description: Retrieves a timeline event based on its ID and incident record.

subcommands.name: list-incident-findings
subcommands.description: Retrieves a list of the IDs of findings, plus their last modified times, that have been identified for a specified incident.

subcommands.name: list-incident-records
subcommands.description: Lists all incident records in your account.

subcommands.name: list-related-items
subcommands.description: List all related items for an incident record.

subcommands.name: list-replication-sets
subcommands.description: Lists details about the replication set configured in your account.

subcommands.name: list-response-plans
subcommands.description: Lists all response plans in your account.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: Lists the tags that are attached to the specified response plan or incident.

subcommands.name: list-timeline-events
subcommands.description: Lists timeline events for the specified incident record.

subcommands.name: put-resource-policy
subcommands.description: Adds a resource policy to the specified response plan.

subcommands.name: start-incident
subcommands.description: Used to start an incident from CloudWatch alarms, EventBridge events, or manually.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: Adds a tag to a response plan.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Removes a tag from a resource.

subcommands.name: update-deletion-protection
subcommands.description: Update deletion protection to either allow or deny deletion of the final Region in a replication set.

subcommands.name: update-incident-record
subcommands.description: Update the details of an incident record.

subcommands.name: update-related-items
subcommands.description: Add or remove related items from the related items tab of an incident record.

subcommands.name: update-replication-set
subcommands.description: Add or delete Regions from your replication set.

subcommands.name: update-response-plan
subcommands.description: Updates the specified response plan.

subcommands.name: update-timeline-event
subcommands.description: Updates a timeline event.

subcommands.name: wait
subcommands.description: Wait until a particular condition is satisfied.

subcommands.name: wait-for-replication-set-active
subcommands.description: Wait for a replication set to become ACTIVE It will poll every 30 seconds until a successful state has been reached.

subcommands.name: wait-for-replication-set-deleted
subcommands.description: Wait for a replication set to be deleted It will poll every 30 seconds until a successful state has been reached.
